pages.text:
Tunnels on the same frequency share one buffer of FE, heat, liquid, gas and items, wherever they are, in any dimension. A tunnel works while its chunk is loaded (a Chunk Loader helps); the buffer itself is kept with the world, not the block.
- FE 4,000,000, heat 400,000 HU, liquid 64,000 mB, gas 64,000 mB, 9 item slots (config).
- Each face moves up to an Arcforged conduit's rate per resource.

# Frequencies
Type a name and press Set to put the tunnel on it (making it if it's new).
- Public (open padlock): anyone may use it.
- Private (closed padlock): you, and players you trust at your Security Terminal.
Click a frequency in the list to switch; click the one it's on to leave it. The x deletes one you made, and everything in its buffer. Each player may make 32.

# Sides
Every face starts with a blank port. In the grid, set each face for each resource: None, Input (it takes that into the frequency) or Output (it gives it, pushing into the block it touches). The port shows a blue ring for input, orange for output, both for a face doing each.
# Security
The tunnel belongs to whoever placed it and follows the usual security; on a private frequency its owner must be the frequency's owner or trusted, or it does nothing.
